title: Purple/Yellow Robin
summary: A Trigger deck. Many of its cards have [Trigger], so getting hit often gives you free plays. Your Leader has [Banish], so its hits stop your opponent's Triggers.
gamePlan: When your Leader attacks, you may trash a [Trigger] card from your hand to add a DON!! from your DON!! deck. This gets you to big plays faster.
Big Mom Pirates searchers (Charlotte Brulee, Streusen) find your key cards. Charlotte Daifuku and Charlotte Oven have [Trigger] Play this card.
Charlotte Smoothie and Sweet 3 Generals add cards from your deck to your Life, which means more Triggers to flip later.
Charlotte Linlin (10 cost) makes every 4000-base-power Trigger Character an 8000 on your turn. Marshall.D.Teach (8 cost) adds a card to your Life.

keyCards.why: Leader with [Banish]. Turns Trigger cards in hand into extra DON!!.
Trash a Trigger card to draw 3. As a Trigger, it searches 5 cards deep.
[Trigger] Play this card: a free 4000-power body when you take damage.
Makes your 4000-power Trigger Characters into 8000s on your turn.
Adds Life, and as a Trigger it K.O.s a Character.

howItWins: A long game. Your Life keeps refilling with Triggers, each hit you take can become a free card, and Linlin turns your board into 8000-power attackers.
weakTo: Opponents with [Banish], which stops your Triggers from firing.
Very fast decks that win before your Life engine gets going.
mulliganTips: Keep a searcher (Brulee or Streusen) and a Trigger card to feed your Leader. This deck has more decisions per turn than the others, so try it after a simpler deck.
